instruction: Calculate the period rate for each data row in a new column titled "Period Rate (%)", format the values as numbers, then identify and highlight the minimum value with blue (#0000ff) font color.

Verified with Python: minimum period rate is 1.1108571429 at row 17 (7.776 / 7). Custom getter extracts the minimum value location and checks for blue font color. Metric awards 0.5 for correct minimum value and 0.5 for blue font highlighting.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct minimum value identification, 0.5 for blue font color highlighting
